name: LWGE
title: DAO under the ENS Constitution
definition: Orga is a DAO; its steward admits members, its members decide its acts when {members}, and they amend its bylaws when {amendment}.
names: Alice and Bob are persons, Orga a DAO.
clauses: ○ Names.  Orga enacts no change that takes a name from its owner, or that treats the owners of names unequally in extending, transferring or using their names.
○ Fees.  Orga sets a fee only to deter the speculative registration of names or to fund its own development.
○ Income.  Orga uses its income first for its own long-term upkeep, and gives funds only to those who undertake these clauses.
○ Integration.  Orga enacts no change that weakens its integration with the outside system of names.
■ Amendment.  The members may amend the bylaws of Orga.
■ Voting against.  A member may vote against a proposed act of Orga, once, in place of voting for it.

0.question: The document does not say who is a member or how ordinary decisions are made. Used: the grassroots DAO as it is (a steward admits; more than half of the members decide). Agreed?

I.question: Who judges that a decision breaches this clause? Default: nobody; it is a promise of the organization, and the members weigh it when they vote.
